en: Color image of a river with rapids in the foreground and calmer water upstream, crossed by a distinctive wooden truss bridge on concrete piers. A person in a striped shirt sits on rocks at the riverbank with a small dog, looking toward the water. The far bank is densely forested with coniferous and deciduous trees under a partly cloudy sky. No printed text is visible on the image side.
